content.title: Cyber Monday Shopping Hits Record. Why Spending Picture is Mixed For E-Commerce Stocks.
content.summary: U.S. shoppers spent record totals online during Cyber Monday and over the course of the so-called "Cyber Week" holiday shopping discount extravaganza that kicked off with Thanksgiving. E-commerce stocks were mixed Tuesday, with Amazon stock higher, but eBay, Etsy and Wayfair lower.

content.title: These e-commerce companies are gaining back 'tremendous' share
content.description:
While Adobe Analytics expects consumers to spend a record $14.2 billion on Cyber Monday purchases, Shopify (SHOP) experienced an outage that disrupted online shopping and caused login issues for merchants around the world.

Wedbush managing director of equity research Scott Devitt discusses the performance of e-commerce platforms and websites as the holiday shopping season kicks off.
